CTL-PLANT.orbit_size_note: Orbit size is the number of DISTINCT OBJECTS, under the FINEST identity (serialisation with no generator in force), among {planted path} u {its images under every verified generator}. It measures how much work the equivalence does. An orbit of size 1 means the equivalence identifies nothing for that object and is reported as such rather than hidden.
CTL-PLANT.distinct_canonical_forms_note: A CORRECTNESS check, not a measure of work: every orbit must collapse to exactly 1 canonical form, or CTL-OBS direction (ii) has found a canonicaliser defect.

plantable_census_attestation.statement: This null was adjudicated against a census containing 16 entries a draw could POSSIBLY have matched (8 md5, 8 sha1), so a false positive was possible. A null against an empty census would be VACUOUS and is not what was run.
